known.title: Update the project-history contract test for viaAgent

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - running the Python starter API suite.
Adding this field also adds `viaAgent: null` to `/api/v1/projects/{project_id}/changes`, which uses `HistoryEntry` in `app/projects/routes.py:162`. However, `src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/tests/test_projects.py:345–350` still asserts that each response contains exactly the previous four fields. Consequently, `test_records_each_project_change_in_the_change_history` fails, breaking the starter's test command and Python smoke check. Update that sibling assertion to include the new nullable attribution field.
